articles.title: How the streets and a social media army led Lula to a historic win in Brazil
articles.description: After ending the first round 2.2 million votes behind his opponent, Flávio Bolsonaro, Lula won the election with a difference of 4 million votes, and will serve a fourth term as president
articles.titleJa: ストリートとソーシャルメディア軍がルーラをブラジルの歴史的勝利に導いた経緯
articles.summary: ルーラは、当初劣勢だったにもかかわらず、400万票差でフラビオ・ボルソナロを破り、4期目の大統領に就任する。

articles.title: Warning Signals: Venezuela and the Risk of AI-Powered Chinese Digital Authoritarianism
articles.description: A report by the Australian think tank ASPI warns that Venezuela could integrate Chinese artificial intelligence into its surveillance system and expand its digital control capabilities.
articles.titleJa: 警告信号：ベネズエラとAIを活用した中国のデジタル権威主義のリスク
articles.summary: 報告書は、ベネズエラが中国のAIを監視システムに統合し、デジタル管理能力を拡大する可能性を警告している。

articles.title: Queer mediums of the cult of María Lionza are redefining the gender binary in Venezuela’s sacred mountain
articles.description: An ethnographic look at Venezuela's María Lionza cult, examining how LGBTQ+ mediums challenge traditional gender roles and face discrimination while channeling diverse spiritual entities
articles.titleJa: マリア・リオンザのカルトのクィアな霊媒が、ベネズエラの聖なる山でジェンダーバイナリを再定義している
articles.summary: ベネズエラのマリア・リオンザ崇拝におけるLGBTQ+の霊媒が、伝統的なジェンダー役割に挑戦し、差別を受けながら霊的存在をチャネリングしている。

articles.title: Xi's anti-corruption campaign ensnares rising star in Chinese Communist Party
articles.description: Chen Jining's fall is part of the widest purge in the party's Politburo in several decades.
articles.titleJa: 習近平の反腐敗運動、中国共産党の新星を捕らえる
articles.summary: 陳吉寧の失脚は、数十年間で最も広範な党政治局における粛清の一部である。

articles.title: Lies, a disguise and surfboard bags: How a jealous Sydney policeman tried to cover up double murder
articles.description: Beau Lamarre was on Wednesday found guilty of murdering his ex Jesse Baird, and Baird's new partner Luke Davies.
articles.titleJa: 嘘、変装、サーフボードのバッグ：嫉妬深いシドニーの警官が二重殺人を隠蔽しようとした方法
articles.summary: ボー・ラマーは水曜日、元パートナーのジェシー・ベアードと彼の新しいパートナーであるルーク・デイビスを殺害した罪で有罪となった。

articles.title: The CCTV that helped convict a Sydney policeman of double murder
articles.description: More than 14,000 hours of CCTV evidence helped convict former police officer Beau Lamarre of killing his ex-partner and the man's new boyfriend in 2024.
articles.titleJa: シドニーの警察官を二重殺人で有罪とするのに役立ったCCTV
articles.summary: 14,000時間以上のCCTV証拠が、元警察官ボー・ラマーが2024年に元パートナーとその新しい恋人を殺害した件で有罪判決を下すのに役立った。

articles.title: Is China behind a wave of AI fake videos targeting Taiwan?
articles.description: The network attacked key figures in the ruling DPP, including President Lai and mayoral candidate Shen.
articles.titleJa: 中国が台湾を標的としたAIフェイク動画の波の背後にいるのか？
articles.summary: このネットワークは、与党民進党の主要人物、具体的には頼総統と mayoral candidate のシェンを攻撃した。

articles.title: Solomon Islands ends controversial security pact with China for Australian treaty
articles.description: Solomon Islands leader Matthew Wale said his country would no longer be a point of regional uncertainty.
articles.titleJa: ソロモン諸島、中国との物議を醸した安全保障協定を終了し、オーストラリアとの条約へ
articles.summary: ソロモン諸島のマシュー・ウェール指導者は、自国がもはや地域の不確実性の要因ではないと述べた。

articles.title: Bangladesh's ex-PM Sheikh Hasina says she plans to return on 16 December
articles.description: Hasina has spoken several times of her desire to return, but this is the first time she has set a date.
articles.titleJa: バングラデシュの元首相シェイク・ハシナ、12月16日に帰国を計画
articles.summary: ハシナはこれまで数回帰国の意思を表明してきたが、具体的な日付を設定したのは今回が初めてである。

articles.title: Indian government has 'lost the plot', says 'cockroach' leader barred from UK flight
articles.description: Saurav Das says immigration authorities at Delhi airport told him his passport had been flagged.
articles.titleJa: インド政府は「道を見失った」と、英国へのフライトを禁じられた「ゴキブリ」リーダーが語る
articles.summary: サウラフ・ダスは、デリー空港の入国管理当局からパスポートにフラグが立てられていると告げられたと述べている。

articles.title: UK sanctions top Myanmar military leaders after Rohingya genocide ruling
articles.description: The UK is joined by several other nations in recognising an ICJ ruling that Myanmar carried out genocide.
articles.titleJa: 英国、ロヒンギャ虐殺判決後、ミャンマーの軍指導者に制裁
articles.summary: 英国は、国際司法裁判所がミャンマーが虐殺を行ったとの判決を認めるいくつかの国に加わった。

articles.title: US to blacklist Asian AI firm Megaspeed after Nvidia scandal
articles.description: Megaspeed has been accused of funneling AI chips to China after a former executive's affair with Jensen Huang became public.
articles.titleJa: 米国、Nvidiaスキャンダル後、アジアのAI企業Megaspeedをブラックリストに掲載へ
articles.summary: 元幹部がジェンスン・フアンとの関係が公になった後、MegaspeedはAIチップを中国に横流ししたと非難されている。

articles.title: These North Koreans say they were spied on, beaten and jailed for being Christian
articles.description: A new report has testimonies from hundreds of defectors who say they were persecuted because of their faith.
articles.titleJa: これらの北朝鮮人は、クリスチャンであるという理由でスパイされ、殴打され、投獄されたと語る
articles.summary: 新しい報告書には、信仰のために迫害されたと語る何百人もの脱北者の証言が含まれている。

articles.title: Brazil requests dispute panel regarding additional duties imposed by the United States
articles.description: At a meeting of the Dispute Settlement Body (DSB) on 24 November, members considered a request from Brazil for the establishment of a dispute panel to review additional US duties on products originating in Brazil as a result of two investigations by the United States under Section 301 of the US Trade Act of 1974.
articles.titleJa: ブラジル、米国による追加関税に関する紛争処理小委員会を要請
articles.summary: ブラジルは、米国が課した追加関税について、WTO紛争処理機関に小委員会設置を要請しました。

articles.title: Trade-facilitating measures help offset rise in new G20 trade restrictions
articles.description: The number of tariff increases and other non-facilitating trade measures introduced by G20 economies rose sharply in the first half of 2026, and the stockpile of such measures reached a record level, according to the WTO's latest report on G20 trade measures. At the same time, G20 economies, representing around 80-85 per cent of global GDP and 75 per cent of international trade, introduced a significant number of trade-facilitating measures, helping to reinforce global trade flows despite heightened geopolitical tensions and economic uncertainty.
articles.titleJa: 貿易円滑化措置がG20の新たな貿易制限の増加を相殺するのに役立つ
articles.summary: G20諸国は貿易制限を増やしましたが、貿易円滑化措置も導入し、世界貿易の流れを支えています。

articles.title: EU launches safeguard investigation into certain composite input materials
articles.description: On 23 November 2026, the European Union notified the WTO’s Committee on Safeguards that it had initiated, on the same day (23 November 2026), a safeguard investigation into imports of certain composite input materials.
articles.titleJa: EU、特定の複合入力材料に対するセーフガード調査を開始
articles.summary: EUは特定の複合入力材料の輸入に対し、セーフガード調査を開始したことをWTOに通告しました。

articles.title: Agriculture group meeting weighs trends in global food market trade
articles.description: Current conditions in global agricultural commodities were the focus of a meeting of the Agricultural Market Information System (AMIS) Global Food Market Information Group, held at WTO headquarters in Geneva on 23-24 November. The AMIS, launched by the G20 group of major economies in 2011, seeks to improve market transparency and strengthen food security by bringing together the principal economies involved in agricultural commodities trade and helping to coordinate policy action in times of market uncertainty.
articles.titleJa: 農業グループ会議で世界の食料市場貿易の動向を検討
articles.summary: WTO本部で農業市場情報システム（AMIS）の会議が開かれ、世界の農産物市場の動向が議論されました。

articles.title: Members review customs valuation notifications, launch new work on preshipment inspection
articles.description: WTO members reviewed compliance with notification obligations under the Customs Valuation Agreement at a meeting on 20 November, at which the Chair highlighted progress in new submissions, while noting persistent gaps. Members also agreed on further work related to preshipment inspection, including updating notifications, examining links with other WTO agreements, and launching the Seventh Triennial Review of the Preshipment Inspection Agreement.
articles.titleJa: 加盟国、関税評価通知を検討し、積載前検査に関する新たな作業を開始
articles.summary: WTO加盟国は関税評価通知の遵守状況を検討し、積載前検査に関する新たな作業を開始することで合意しました。

articles.title: Panama submits request to join Expansion of the Information Technology Agreement
articles.description: Panama has submitted a request to join the 2015 Expansion of the Information Technology Agreement (ITA II), the Chair of the Committee of Participants on the Expansion of Trade in Information Technology Products, Mr Shih-Chun Weng of Chinese Taipei, informed members at a meeting on 19 November. Panama said joining ITA II will help it to advance its goal of a more knowledge-based, innovation-driven and technologically advanced economy.
articles.titleJa: パナマ、情報技術協定拡大への参加を申請
articles.summary: パナマは情報技術協定（ITA II）への参加を申請し、技術主導型経済への移行を目指します。

articles.title: Applications open for WIPO-WTO Executive Programme on Intellectual Property Issues
articles.description: The Secretariat of the World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO) and the Secretariat of the World Trade Organization (WTO) are now accepting applications for the WIPO-WTO Executive Programme on Intellectual Property Issues for Senior Government Officials. The activity will take place from 1 to 12 February 2027 at the headquarters of the WIPO and of the WTO in Geneva, Switzerland.
articles.titleJa: WIPO-WTO知的財産問題幹部プログラムの応募受付開始
articles.summary: WIPOとWTOが、政府高官向けの知的財産問題に関する幹部プログラムの応募受付を開始しました。

articles.title: Spotlight on trade fundamentals at annual WTO student event
articles.description: Over 200 students joined policymakers, executives and thought leaders on 18 November at the WTO to discuss trade fundamentals at the WTO's annual student-only event on trade, titled WTO 101: Trade Rules!. Now in its third year, the event saw spirited discussions on the key issues facing the multilateral system and its implications for the next generation.
articles.titleJa: WTO年次学生イベントで貿易の基礎に焦点を当てる
articles.summary: WTOの年次学生向けイベント「WTO 101: 貿易ルール！」が開催され、貿易の基礎が議論されました。

articles.title: Trade Policy Review: Peru
articles.description: The sixth review of the trade policies and practices of Peru takes place on 18 and 20 November 2026. The basis for the review is a report by the WTO Secretariat and a report by the Government of Peru.
articles.titleJa: 貿易政策検討：ペルー
articles.summary: ペルーの貿易政策と慣行に関する第6回レビューが、WTO事務局とペルー政府の報告書に基づいて行われます。

articles.title: New trade-restrictive measures surge but WTO members step up trade facilitation efforts
articles.description: The pace of newly-introduced tariffs and other non-facilitating measures rose sharply in the first half of 2026, while the stockpile of such measures reached a record level, according to the WTO Director-General's latest annual overview of developments in the international trading environment. At the same time, WTO members introduced a significant number of trade-facilitating measures, helping to sustain global trade flows despite heightened geopolitical tensions and economic uncertainty.
articles.titleJa: 新たな貿易制限措置が急増するも、WTO加盟国は貿易円滑化努力を強化
articles.summary: 新たな貿易制限措置が増加する一方で、WTO加盟国は貿易円滑化努力を強化し、世界貿易を支えています。
